Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you
reported. Please state your full name for the record.
A: Sure. I'd rather keep my personal details out of it, so I'll just say I'm the driver of the vehicle that was hit.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was in a shopping center parking lot in Conroe, Texas, near one of the main entrances. I was pulling out of a
parking space when the other car came down the aisle.
Q: How fast would you estimate you were moving when the impact occurred?
A: I'd say I was going very slowly, maybe a walking pace. I was just backing out and had almost cleared the space.
Q: And the other vehicle, how was it moving?
A: It was coming through the lane at a steady speed. I didn't see it until it was pretty close, and then it clipped the rear
quarter panel of my car.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did you feel any pain or discomfort right after the impact?
A: Not right away. About an hour later my neck started to stiffen, and by the next morning my lower back was sore
too. I've been dealing with that since.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment for those symptoms?
A: Yes, I saw a doctor and was diagnosed with a neck strain and a lower back strain. I'm doing physical therapy twice
a week now.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I want to get my car repaired and get back to normal. I'm willing to provide any records you need.
Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
